# Content Sweep — Findings (Launch Program Step 3)

**Date:** 2026-11-19 (revised 2026-11-20 after the 5-agent implementation review, §6) · **Plan:** `PLAN_CONTENT_SWEEP.md` · **Tool:** `pnpm content:sweep` (`scripts/content-sweep.mjs` + `scripts/sweep/`)
**Generated data (do not edit by hand):** `docs/audit/content-sweep/findings.tsv` (every hit: check · class · locale · book · file:line · zone · render · match · context), `summary.md` (counts), `names.tsv` (name-pair inventory). **Precision sources:** `content-sweep/precision.tsv` (every precision figure below, with its sample and who measured it).
**Snapshot:** `main` @ `c8ed3ed` + this branch (no content changed); **regenerated in Step 4 batch 1** (code only: Sources blocks now render; the ES TOC is skipped — S16 3 → 0; the chapter pill prints the i18n status — S8 pill-word 64 → retired; sigla no longer open italics — S15 siglum 19 → retired; total 20,423 → 20,337). Re-run after every Step-4 batch and diff. **Regenerated in Step 4 batch 2:** 20,337 → 20,079 — the 133 v3.3 stamps re-stamped (S8 `ruleset-v3.3` −125, S10 `stamp-field` −125, `prose-stamp` −8); nothing else moved.

> **How to read the numbers.** Every verse exists twice (continuous reading + verse study); lexical checks count the **verse-study copy only** (one hit per verse) — fixing a hit means editing both copies, and S6a/S6e/S7d prove the copies agree. PT-BR/DE/ES mirror EN, so most classes are ≈ 4 × the EN figure. **Render** = `now` (a reader sees it) · `no` (unrendered front matter / parser-dropped). *(The first pass had a third state, `after-4a`, for the "Sources consulted" blocks; Step 4 batch 1 renders them (D2/B2), so they count as `now` since then.)* **Precision** = hand-verified share of a seeded sample (`node scripts/content-sweep-sample.mjs N CHECK CLASS`), sourced in `precision.tsv`; "review list" = a class that needs per-instance judgment, not a defect count. **Counts are lower bounds** where a check is heuristic (S11, S14 verb forms, S20).

## 5. What the sweep does not do

It does not judge Rule 13 uncertainty levels, Rule 2 slash correctness (already parity-tested), Rule 27 inclusive language, DE noun capitalization (grammatical), or the ES pronoun-accent class (`el`/`él` etc. — a reading pass). Its classifiers are heuristics: use/mention, the T-20 article accounting, the ES dominance and generative rules, the vós verb forms and the Rule 20 title list produce **work lists for a human pass**, not automatic fixes. Step 4 promotes a class to a blocking `content-lint` rule only after it is cleared (playbook T-14).

## 6. Implementation review (2026-11-20) — what changed

Five adversarial reviewers (tool correctness · independent recall · precision/rule fidelity · docs/completeness · gate/CI/infra) re-derived the results with their own scripts. No blockers; every major finding was fixed and re-verified:

- **Tool bugs fixed:** companion "G." (Curiosities) was labelled a Sources block (Sources is now decided by heading words); PROPHECY files now follow the prophecy parser (only entries with a Verse field, and only their recognized fields and readings, render); the INTRODUCTION book card is zoned as rendered; the gloss normalizer dropped the word before a transliteration (the cause of the first draft's "58 EN word differences" — the real figure is 4); verse-text italics were blanked from the ES accent check; S18 missed sentences opening with italics or ¿/¡; S1c missed DE "HERRN", skipped headings and caps titles, and its use/mention cues were English-only; S2a matched "son of Manasseh"; the use/mention negator reached across commas; `--check S1` also selected S10–S19, and a bad `--check` argument crashed or passed silently (now exit 2).
- **Recall gaps closed:** S3 πίστις, Ἰουδαῖοι, DE Umkehr/Eintauchung; S13 lowercase yehudim; S7a DE/ES + doubled articles + possessives; S5d continuous reading + accent-folded redundant pairs; S6e gloss placement; S6f J-007; S8 pill vs badge; S9 AI provenance, Tier-2 jargon, "Rules N"; S12 Win-1252 capitals; S14 vós verb forms; S11 future/-ción/-mente rules and homographs; new **S20** (Rule 20 titles), **S21** (marker governance), **S22** (labels and icons).
- **Doc corrections:** headline 5 (artifact); headline 3 (DE 9 → 28; Genesis 10 → 4); L1/L2/L3/L5/L6/L7/L8 re-cut against the rule text and the logs; S13 file count (12 + 1); S11 file count (56 of 102, not 72); precision figures now sourced in `precision.tsv`.
- **Tests:** the real-corpus test pinned current defects (it required "YHWHs", 9 mojibake lines, 190 T-20 hits to exist), so Step-4 fixes would have turned the gate red. Recall is now proven on frozen real lines (`scripts/sweep/__tests__/fixtures/recall-anchors.json`, each with its source file:line); the live-corpus test asserts tool health only; an anti-vacuity test requires every check id to fire on some fixture. Mutation testing: see `EXECUTION_HISTORY.md`.
